scripts.deploy: npm run build && git add . && git commit -m 'Deploy to gh-pages' && git subtree push --prefix dist origin gh-pages
scripts.deploy:unix: npm run build && git add . && git commit -m 'Deploy to gh-pages at $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")' && git subtree push --prefix dist origin gh-pages
scripts.deploy:win: npm run build && git add . && git commit -m "Deploy to gh-pages at %DATE:~10,4%-%DATE:~4,2%-%DATE:~7,2% %TIME:~0,2%:%TIME:~3,2%" && git subtree push --prefix dist origin gh-pages
